title: pilosella floribunda subsp. regiomontana
intro: Pilosella floribunda subsp. regiomontana, commonly known as a type of flowering plant in the dandelion family, is a subspecies of Pilosella floribunda. This plant is reported to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce the risk of certain diseases. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella floribunda subsp. regiomontana include its potential to inhibit platelet aggregation, lower blood pressure, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
